description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing channel sidebar interactions in Mattermost, including creating categories, moving channels, multi-selection, and drag-and-drop state management.

methods.name: setUnreadFilterEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the unread filter in the channel sidebar.

methods.name: setDraggingState
methods.description: Sets the dragging state for channel sidebar drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: stopDragging
methods.description: Stops the drag operation in the channel sidebar.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new channel category for a team, optionally with specified channels, and updates the state with the new category ID.

methods.name: addChannelsInSidebar
methods.description: Adds a channel to a category in the sidebar at the first position.

methods.name: moveChannelsInSidebar
methods.description: Moves one or multiple channels to a specified category and position, accounting for archived channels and multi-selection.

methods.name: adjustTargetIndexForMove
methods.description: Calculates the correct target index for moving channels within a category, considering archived channels and current order.

methods.name: clearChannelSelection
methods.description: Clears multi-channel selection in the sidebar.

methods.name: multiSelectChannelAdd
methods.description: Adds a channel to the current multi-selection in the sidebar.

methods.name: multiSelectChannelTo
methods.description: Selects a range of channels between the last selected and the current channel, enabling multi-selection via shift-like behavior.
